stories.title: People are giving up their pets due to costs — and rehoming them is more expensive too
stories.summary: The cost of pet care is rising. Petflation is affecting more than the cost of food and care; it's also making it costlier to transport pets between shelters, the key to getting many animals adopted.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: People are giving up their pets due to costs — and rehoming them is more expensive too. The cost of pet care is rising. Source: NPR Business.
